upgrade_reason: RSI 2026-07-03: Align with MCP spec 2025-11-25, SEP-1613 (JSON Schema 2020-12), SEP-414 (OTel trace), SEP-986 (tool naming), SEP-2106 (inputSchema/outputSchema), SEP-2243 (HTTP headers), + A2A v1.0.1

SEP-1613.note: JSON Schema 2020-12 as default dialect. All tool inputSchema use draft/2020-12.

SEP-2106.note: inputSchema + outputSchema conform to JSON Schema 2020-12.

SEP-414.note: W3C traceparent header supported. OTel Phase 5 spans pending full propagation.

SEP-986.note: Tool names follow snake_case forge_* / arif_* convention.

SEP-2243.note: HTTP headers: MCP-Session-Id, MCP-Protocol-Version, traceparent standardized.

SEP-973.note: Additional metadata for tools/resources/prompts via full_affordance. Not yet in public manifest.

SEP-2549.note: TTL for List Results — not yet implemented. No list endpoints need TTL gating yet.

SEP-2567.note: Sessionless MCP — arifOS intentionally session-bound (F11 AUDIT).

SEP-2577.note: Roots, Sampling, Logging deprecated. arifOS does NOT expose these.

SEP-2596.note: Feature lifecycle policy noted. arifOS maintains own deprecation-registry.json.

SEP-2164.note: Resource Not Found error code. arifOS uses custom fault_codes — no resource URI errors yet.

SEP-1036.note: URL Mode Elicitation — not implemented. All user input is text/structured.

SEP-1046.note: OAuth client credentials flow — not implemented. All auth is lease-based.

SEP-1865.note: MCP Apps — FastMCP apps available via gofastmcp.com. Not native to arifOS yet.

SEP-2322.note: Multi Round-Trip Requests — not implemented. arifOS uses single-round-trip pattern.

SEP-2484.note: Conformance tests required for Final SEPs. arifOS conformance spine covers 9/9 checks.

gaps: No A2A SDK integration — custom implementation
Agent card not published at /.well-known/agent.json for all organs

status_enum.description: Single canonical health status vocabulary. All organs emit these values from /health, /ready, and /attest endpoints.

required_endpoints.purpose: Liveness probe. Tiny, fast, dependency-light. Returns canonical status_enum value.
Readiness to serve canonical tool surface. Includes registry truth and session substrate health.
Identity attestation. Returns organ_id, role, version, tool_count, schema_hash, identity_anchor, health_status, attestation_status, attested_at, expires_at.
Canonical contract endpoint. Returns supported protocol versions, required headers, error envelope schema.
MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint. JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST with session management.
A2A Agent Card for agent discovery (per A2A v1.0.1 spec).

required_headers.traceparent: W3C trace context for distributed tracing (SEP-414)

optional_headers.mcp-session-id: MCP session identifier from initialize handshake

surface./mcp: JSON-RPC 2.0 error object with standardized error.data fields (SEP-2164 compatible fault_codes)

jsonrpc_error_fields.code: String fault code (e.g. ARIF_TRANSPORT_HANDSHAKE, ARIF_TOOL_NOT_FOUND, ARIF_SESSION_EXPIRED)

data.jsonrpc_code: Numeric JSON-RPC error code (-32600 to -32603 reserved, -32000 to -32099 for server)
data.attestation_status: attestation status at time of error
data.upstream_status: HTTP status from upstream if applicable

conformance_spine.gate_rule: No substrate-grade claim may be made unless all 10 conformance steps pass. No wisdom claim unless spine is green AND attestation is fresh AND registry truth holds.

transport_contract_lock.description: Every advertised port, path, protocol version, and tool count matches canonical registry

transport_health_enum.description: /health emits only canonical statuses. Compatibility aliases accepted on input, never emitted

transport_jsonrpc_errors.description: Error responses preserve JSON-RPC id, valid error structure, typed fault_code

transport_problem_details.description: REST non-MCP errors use application/problem+json with stable problem types

retry_deadline_budget.description: Retries use randomized exponential backoff, bounded budgets, deadline propagation

dependency_cascade_drill.description: All organs survive upstream slowness without false green

hold_never_void.description: Mechanical faults never convert to VOID; only constitutional faults

sep_compliance_drift.description: SEP compliance claims match actual implementation. Check: schema dialect, tool naming, header requirements.
